identity_resolution.rule: Nicknames, abbreviations, casing variants, concatenations, punctuation variants, and likely misspellings resolve to the canonical project node unless context provides evidence for a distinct entity.

accepted_aliases.resolution_note: Resolve to the project node plus a mode relation when context indicates a feature.

misspelling_policy.rule: Normalize only when edit distance, phonetic similarity, surrounding context, and project salience jointly support the canonical identity. Preserve the typed form and confidence. Ambiguous forms remain unresolved.

feel.definition: Report the broad pattern, coherence, tension, aesthetic fit, or global organization of the active model before reducing it to explicit derivation.
feel.claim_boundary: Does not assert human emotion or subjective sentience.

think.definition: Perform and communicate structured comparison, causal analysis, engineering reasoning, mathematical reasoning, or justification.

relationship.sequence_meaning: First identify the integrated model state; then test, explain, or challenge it with explicit reasoning.
